Documentation.UserDocu: Feature for creating and manipulating Technical Drawing GeomHatch areas
translateLabel(translationContext, objectBaseName, objectUniqueName). No return value. Replace the current label with a translated version where possible.
findByName() - the faces of Source whose saved name another face carries now and whose saved geometry neither has: a list of (index, was, now, sameGeometry). A recompute does not move them.
repointByName() - those faces taken by name, whatever their geometry, as the hatch's edit does. Returns the list of (index, was, now, sameGeometry) taken.
